question: How much rest do agents need between shifts?

response.query: How much rest do agents need between shifts?

chunk.heading_path: Working Time Policy > 3. Rest and recovery > 3.1 Rest between shifts
chunk.text: Employees must receive at least 11 hours of rest between the end of one shift and the start of the next.

chunk.heading_path: Working Time Policy > 3. Rest and recovery > 3.2 Consecutive working days
chunk.text: No employee may work more than 6 consecutive days.

chunk.heading_path: Working Time Policy > 2. Working hours > 2.1 Daily hours
chunk.text: No employee may be scheduled for more than 9 hours in a working day, excluding unpaid breaks.
